subject: Getting individual x-axes per subplot for facet_grid / getting one individual y-axis per row for facet_wrap

messages.author: f86edd94481e636d
messages.subject: Getting individual x-axes per subplot for facet_grid / getting one individual y-axis per row for facet_wrap
parts:
Dear all,
the following may be a naive question, but I failed to find any comments
on this via Google. I suspect it might just be beyond the scope of what
is intended to be easily achievable with ggplot2. I am trying to use
facet_grid to create subplots according to two grouping variables:

ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
facet_grid(majorgroup ~ minorgroup, scales = "free")

Everything works out fine, except that I want to have x-axes underneath
every subplot. Each axis should be fitted to the respective subset of
the data.

Using
facet_wrap(~ majorgroup + minorgroup, scales = "free_x", ncol=2)
does not work for me, because this fixes the y scales across all rows while
facet_wrap(~ majorgroup + minorgroup, scales = "free", ncol=2)
does not fix the y scales within the row. There should be only one
y-axis per row, but it should be independent of all the other rows.

In short: I want the x-axis different for every subplot (does not seem
to be possible with facet_grid) and the y-axis different for each row,
but same within row (does not seem to be possible with facet_wrap). Is
there any way to achieve what I want?

Best wishes,
Markus
